name: cat-walk
description: A text cat walks, sleeps and gets dizzy above the prompt while you wait, and beeps when the AI's reply is done.

idleSeconds.title: Idle seconds before the cat comes out
idleSeconds.description: Seconds without typing before the cat walks out by itself. off = only on the button, /cat or when a prompt is sent.

style.title: Cat style
style.description: two-line: ears on a row above the face. one-line: one row; the ears become the brackets of the face.

speedFastest.title: Fastest speed (ms per column)
speedFastest.description: The cat changes speed at random between the fastest and the slowest, holding each for a while. Smaller is faster.

speedSlowest.title: Slowest speed (ms per column)
speedSlowest.description: See the fastest speed. Larger is slower.

beep.title: Beep when a reply is done
beep.description: Plays the beep sequence after the AI finishes a reply normally (not after Esc, an error or a refusal). /cat off also silences it. off runs nothing.

beepSequence.title: Beep sequence
beepSequence.description: Comma-separated Hz:ms notes; Hz 0 is a silent gap. Up to 12 notes, 10-1000 ms each, 37-32767 Hz. Default 880:100,1320:150 (two rising tones).

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the cat's labels and /config titles. auto follows Claude Code's Language setting, then LANG / LC_ALL; anything not Traditional Chinese is English.
